## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `LocalSetup`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `local-setup`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **LocalSetup**.

## Step 2: Download WSO2 Integrator

1. <!-- manual: Visit the [WSO2 Integrator Downloads page](https://wso2.com/products/downloads/?product=wso2integrator). -->
2. <!-- manual: Select your operating system: Windows, macOS, or Linux. -->
3. <!-- manual: Download the installer for WSO2 Integrator. -->

## Step 3: Install WSO2 Integrator

1. <!-- manual: Windows - Run the .msi installer and follow the installation wizard. -->

## Step 4: Sign in to WSO2 Integrator

1. On the **Get Started** page, select **Sign In** in the top-right corner.
2. The WSO2 Integration Platform sign-in page opens up in your default browser. Sign in using your preferred method.
3. When the browser prompts you, click **Open WSO2 Integrator** to return to the IDE.
4. The IDE shows a **Successfully signed into WSO2 Integration Platform** notification, and your account avatar appears in the top-right corner.
